messages:
Samir Khan: heads up — since the routing-policy rollout at 09:10 were seeing console charts hang on initial paint. main thread pegged, large bundle parse + repeated fetches. anyone else?

deploy-bot: deployed routing/policy-v2 to prod at 2026-03-20T09:10:12Z by jess. (canary -> prod) :rocket:

Jess Lee: yup noticed it on charts in eu-prod canary earlier, but thought it was a weird CDN hiccup. saw lots of repeated /api/chart/timeseries calls.

Marco Alvarez: looking at request logs — routing/policy-v2 changed region fallback order. we now bounce some chart requests across regions which (a) invalidates in-browser cache keys and (b) triggers extra telemetry sampling calls.

Priya Patel: also seeing quota spikes on metrics-proxy: a lot of 429s for the telemetry sampler endpoint. console retries -> exponential backoff disabled? might be aggressive.

Samir Khan: snippet from client console: 

```
GET /api/chart/timeseries?chart_id=cpu&range=1h 200
GET /api/telemetry/sample?route=eu-west 429
client.ts: fetchTimeseries -> onError retryImmediately -> fetchTimeseries
// repeat x5
```

Samir Khan: so the client retries are amplifying the cross-region misroutes and chewing main-thread (parsing + setState churn).

Jess Lee: PR 987 changed the client routing header to `x-rw-route: prefer-region`. that plus route-flip fallback might be the culprit. we flipped fallback window to 0.5s.

Marco Alvarez: quick mitigation options: (1) rollback routing/policy-v2, (2) patch client to add backoff before retry, (3) throttle telemetry sampler in the client, (4) route chart data to read-replica cache layer.

Priya Patel: short-term I'd vote (2) + (3) as safe toggles. (1) is disruptive to infra oncall. we can flip a feature-flag for client retry strategy.

Samir Khan: agreed. can someone toggle client retry flag for prod? Also can infra throttle sampler at metrics-proxy to return 503 quickly so client fallback is more graceful?

infra-bot: metrics-proxy currently supports quota-adjustment -> can apply per-path rate limits for "/api/telemetry/sample". Applying soft-503 policy now to eu-west for 5m.

Jess Lee: Ill open a tiny PR to revert the aggressive retry (client) and add jitter/backoff. will link canary when ready. if infra-bot applied soft-503 that should cut amplification.

Marco Alvarez: I'll run a canary with routing/policy-v2 but with `prefer-region` disabled for charts only. want to validate cache-key stability.

Samir Khan: action items: Jess -> patch client retry & flag (ETA 30m). Marco -> chart-only route test (ETA 45m). Priya -> monitor metrics-proxy quotas + rollback plan if errors increase. Infra -> soft-503 applied. Everyone post quick perf numbers to thread. :eyes: 

Priya Patel: posting initial numbers in 5m — latency p50 for chart paint went from 230ms -> 980ms since deploy, main-thread CPU up ~3x.

Jess Lee: created PR 1199 for retry-backoff. will canary to 10% after merge.

Samir Khan: thanks. if p50 doesn't drop after these mitigations -> we'll ship rollback of routing/policy-v2.

infra-bot: note: rollback window requires 20m of stability checks across EU and US regions.

Jess Lee: canary results @10%: chart paint p50 down to 320ms, error rate for sampler down 70%. pushing to 50% now.

Samir Khan: great, keep it moving. will follow up with a postmortem draft once stabilized.
